blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) code ko design aur organize (tarteeb se rakhne) karne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis se code sambhalna aur samajhna aasan hota hai. Sochein aap khilona blocks se ek model city (chhota sa namoone ka shehar) bana rahe hain. Is shehar mein har building (imarat), gaari aur insaan ek alag cheez (entity) hai jise aap design kar sakte hain aur jis se kaam le sakte hain. OOP mein inhi alag cheezon ko objects kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Model city ki misaal mein har building ya gaari OOP mein kis cheez ko represent karti hai (kis cheez ki jagah hai)?
blocks.explanation: Object: aisi alag cheez jis ka apna data (attributes) aur apna behaviour (methods, yani kaam) hota hai.

items: OOP: program ko alag alag objects (cheezon) ki shakal mein banana.
